description: Works out the ROAS at which an Etsy shop's Etsy Ads pay for themselves (break-even ROAS = order ÷ what an ad order keeps after Etsy's fees and costs), the most an ad can cost per sale, and, with the shop's ROAS, what the ads gain or lose a month. It fits a seller who asks whether Etsy Ads are worth it, what ROAS they need, or whether to turn ads off. Takes the item price, shipping charged, materials, label cost, and the daily budget or exact monthly spend; packaging is optional ($1 typical, flagged) and ROAS from the Etsy Ads page adds the monthly gain or loss and the fix. Returns the margin, break-even ROAS, ad sales and earnings, the monthly gain or loss and, when the ads lose money, the fix and what it's worth. US dollars; dated Etsy rules with sources. Free, no sign-in. Takes numbers only; nothing is stored.

adsDailyBudget.description: Etsy Ads daily budget, US dollars, $1 or more (Etsy's smallest; assumed fully spent, 30 days a month). Or send adsMonthlySpend.

adsMonthlySpend.description: Exact Etsy Ads spend last 30 days, US dollars. Or send adsDailyBudget.

itemPrice.description: Typical item price, US dollars, before shipping.

materials.description: Materials and supplies per item, US dollars.

packaging.description: Packaging per order in US dollars, or mailer (about $1), box (about $3) or not-sure. Left out: $1, a weakly sourced typical figure, flagged as a default.

roas.description: Return on ad spend, last 30 days (Etsy Ads page): ad revenue ÷ ad spend, such as 1.5. Left out: only the break-even is returned.

shippingCharged.description: What the buyer pays for shipping, US dollars (0 if free).

name: sellerprofit_ads_breakeven

isDefault.description: True when the value isn't the seller's own number or tap: a default their own figure would replace.

breakEvenRoas.description: 1 ÷ margin: ads pay back at this ROAS or more. Null when each order loses money before the ad.

additive.description: False when this fix's value is part of another fix's, not on top of it.

estimate.description: True when the fix's dollars rest on a third-party rate (Amazon's fulfillment fees): say "about" and "estimated" when quoting it.

monthly.description: What the fix is worth a month in US dollars, at the seller's numbers, if orders hold; null when no monthly total can be known.

ordersCanFall.description: How far orders could fall (a fraction) before the fix leaves the seller worse off; null when there's no limit or it doesn't apply.

text.description: The fix in plain words, with its condition ("if orders hold").

link.description: Opens the matching page on sellerprofitdoctor.com. Carries none of the figures sent.

monthlyGainOrLoss.description: earnedAfterCosts − spend: negative means the ads cost more than they bring in.

profitPerAdOrder.description: What an order an ad brought keeps before the ad: order − Etsy fees − materials − packaging − label (no Offsite fee on it). Also the most an ad can cost per sale.

rates.description: Which rules the numbers use, as of when, and where they come from.

asOf.description: The day the platform's fee table was last checked against its sources (YYYY-MM-DD).

estimatesLine.description: Amazon only: which rates are third-party estimates (FBA, storage, returns and the rest sit behind the Seller Central login). Say so when citing them.

recheckBy.description: The day the table is due for its next check.

title: Break-even ROAS for Etsy Ads
